fairUseLimits.title: Fair Use Limits
fairUseLimits.description: Per-tier sliding-window quotas applied to chat messages. Each tier has its own bucket so users can send more cheap-tier messages without exhausting expensive-tier capacity.

validationError.limit: Messages must be a positive integer.
validationError.windowHours: Window must be at least 0.01 hours.

academyMinimumModuleSeconds.title: Academy: Minimum time per video page
academyMinimumModuleSeconds.description: How many seconds each video page must be open and visible before a chapter can be completed. This measures time on the page, not video playback.
academyMinimumModuleSeconds.label: Seconds per video page
academyMinimumModuleSeconds.loadError: Failed to load the minimum time.

academyMinimumModuleSeconds.hint: 0 disables the minimum time. Chapters already completed stay valid.
